description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's ref management, specifically handling packed references and their coverage by loose refs. It sets up Git repositories, manipulates refs, and verifies behaviors related to packed-refs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and script.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the Git timer for deterministic testing.
